sym: bintray jcenter malicious maven packages impersonation
key: android dependencies pulled malware from jcenter
pa: malicious maven packages were published to jcenter through an impersonation attack
pb: an attacker impersonated a vendor and planted malicious maven artifacts in jcenter

pd: android apps included malware after resolving dependencies from the poisoned jcenter repository

sf: 冒充发布的 Maven 包在 JCenter 待了一年多，Android 项目依赖后带进了恶意代码
rc: 攻击者冒充合法发布者向 Bintray JCenter 植入恶意 Maven 包，相关包存在一年多并被多个 Android 应用依赖，导致恶意代码进入应用

sf: 代码托管仓库里放了能读备份的密钥，用户密码哈希随备份一起暴露
rc: Bitly 托管源代码仓库中包含可访问备份的凭证，导致备份数据及密码哈希暴露

sym: browserstack old prototype shellshock production breach

rc: BrowserStack 一台仍存在 Shellshock 漏洞的旧原型机保存了密钥，攻击者利用其导致生产系统入侵

sym: chef supermarket low health check timeout crash

sf: Chef 的新社区站点刚上线，健康检查阈值太短把正常实例判死，服务很快挂了

sym: mars climate orbiter metric english unit mismatch

sym: mozilla firefox addons certificate expired outage

sym: stack exchange regex backtracking health check outage

rc: Stack Exchange 底层正则引擎在处理一篇帖子时发生灾难性回溯，请求处理阻塞并导致健康检查失败，站点中断

sym: duo request queue overloaded database capacity

se: Duo 请求队列压垮数据库容量，监控不足导致级联故障
sf: Duo 的请求队列越积越多，数据库容量和监控都不够，最后整个服务级联失败
rc: Duo 请求队列超过数据库现有容量，容量规划与监控不足，导致级联故障

sym: eslint npm maintainer account malicious packages

sym: github aggregation switch mlag failover stonith

rc: trivago 在执行手工重复任务时误删 Azure Active Directory 安全组，该组控制 GitHub 组织访问，导致全部工程师失去代码平台权限
fix: 重建安全组与成员关系，并为高风险手工操作增加保护

sym: zerodha order management system million unit order overload
key: penny stock order split into hundred thousand trades
pa: an order for one million penny stock units was split into over one hundred thousand trades
pb: the unexpected trade count collapsed the order management system
pc: the provider had never seen such a burst and its oms could not keep up
pd: zerodha and refinitiv restored order processing after the oms collapse
se: Zerodha 百万股订单被拆成十万笔成交，OMS 过载崩溃
sf: 一笔百万股的仙股订单被拆成十几万笔，Zerodha 的 OMS 从没见过这种量，直接崩了
rc: Zerodha 一笔 100 万单位仙股订单被拆成超过 10 万笔交易，远超常见数百笔，导致 Refinitiv 提供的 OMS 过载崩溃
fix: 限制拆单规模并扩容 OMS 处理能力
